title: Hollow zinc phthalocyanine nanoshells: quick low temperature synthesis, enhanced near-IR absorption and water-dispersibility for photocatalysis and phototherapy
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4993-4998
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07242E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shweta Sharma, Amiya Priyam
A quick ultrasonic method has been developed to synthesize crystalline and hollow zinc phthalocyanine (ZnPc) nanoshells (HZPNS) capped with thioglycolic acid (TGA), that show a new NIR peak and enhanced photocatalytic and photothermal activity.
